Stackyard is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows and macOS that helps developers manage their software development kits (SDKs) and toolchains. It identifies all installed SDKs, tracks which projects use them, and provides one-click solutions to fix broken setups and free up disk space by removing unused versions.

The Human Box is a free, browser-based civilization sandbox simulation written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. It allows users to observe or influence autonomous tribes as they develop languages, cultures, technologies, and engage in complex societal interactions from the stone age to the computer age, all running client-side without a server or LLM.
